title: Wanted to Share a Couple I Have.
content: The House on the Hill- I remember it the most as driving in a car up a windy road to the house on the hill. The basement and the attic are terrifying but it’s almost like they must be explored regardless of the fear I felt. The basement and attic are liminal spaces as well. They just keep going. You have to go through holes in the walls and stuff. The Weird Spiral Tower Dorm/ School- I remember someone posting about a spiral tower dorm thing and bad weather happening outside. This one gives me chills because it’s so specific. I was in a dorm room high in a weird medieval stone tower at a school of some sorts. Kind of like hogwarts but not really at all. More wood and stone. There was some kind of fair going on in the square in the center outside. Like booths and stuff set up. Then a tornado happens and I remember seeing it and everyone being rushed back to their dorms. So weird. The Lake With the Island in the Middle- This one is accessed by walking down a flat stone creekbed to get to this weird crystal clear lake with weird colorful fish and coral reefs in it. One version of this is allowed to be there I guess. The other one I’m not. The other one happened after my stepdad passed away. We were hiking through the woods and we got to this large wooden swinging bridge that led to a lake with a large stone or island in the middle. Two guards were guarding either side of the bridge entrance which was only large enough to go single file. It spanned a great distance though. He excitedly ran into the bridge and toward the lake. The guards stopped me when I tried to pass. They only let him through. That one was weird to me. It wasn’t a very good time in my life. The Festival/Circus- This one is usually in a large field and I see campers parked everywhere and a central area where so much shit is going down. Like a small circus over here, booths with weird stuff in it over there. Usually in this one every time I have it I’m trying to use a phone to call my girlfriend or someone because I feel almost panicky. I guess because the phone won’t work. It’s like blank and I can’t see anything to call anyone and couldn’t remember phone numbers. There’s so many more that I’ve had. I’m very interested to hear anybody else’s version of the House on the Hill. Shit creeps me out. I’ve noticed a trend with that one.
